title: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$\alpha$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
abstract: arXiv:2608.16319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $\alpha$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $\alpha$-release, RelArena-$\alpha$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. translated_title: 推进开放且可复现的关系学习：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel 和 RPI
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16319v1 公告类型：新  摘要：Prior Labs 在关系学习领域的首次发布展示了我们对开放科学的持续承诺。我们开源了三款软件，期望能加速该领域研究向有意义的实际影响迈进。我们旨在根据社区的反馈并与之合作，进一步引导开发方向。鉴于开发尚处于早期阶段，我们的 α 版本主要面向研究人员和早期采用者。过去几年中，出现了多种关系学习的数据集和任务，但社区尚未就这些任务上比较不同方法的可靠、可复现方式达成共识。我们的 α 版本 RelArena-α 提供了一个统一框架，用于在 RelBench v1 上运行和比较基线方法，通过标准化数据加载、评估协议、调参制度，并支持自定义调参的系统，灵感来源于诸如 TabArena 等成熟的表格基准。
tldr: 本文通过开源 RelArena-α 统一框架、TabPFN-Rel 和 RPI 三款软件，旨在建立关系学习任务的可复现比较标准，以推动该领域开放科学和实际应用。
en_tdlr: This paper open-sources three software tools, including RelArena-α, a unified framework for reproducible comparison on relational learning tasks, to advance open science and real-world impact.
